title: Countries with Extradition Treaties with Singapore
what_it_is: Countries with Extradition Treaties with Singapore

sections.label: Singapore extradition treaties and arrangements
sections.summary: Singapore has special extradition arrangements with Malaysia and Brunei, a pending treaty with Indonesia, and is party to multilateral extradition instruments.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Law (a) how many countries have signed bilateral extradition treaties with Singapore; (b) why there is no extradition treaty with Thailand; and (c) what are the considerations before Singapore seeks an extradition treaty with another country.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: We also have special extradition arrangements with Malaysia and Brunei based on the endorsement of arrest warrants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: We have signed an Extradition Treaty and a Defence Cooperation Agreement as a package with Indonesia, which is pending ratification by Indonesia.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Singapore is also a party to a number of multilateral instruments which provide for extradition.

sections.label: Steps for extradition treaty
sections.summary: An extradition treaty requires a common desire from both countries and examination of each other's legal systems for compatibility.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: For Singapore to have an extradition treaty with another country, for example, Thailand, there must, first, be a common desire from both countries to have an arrangement for the reciprocal handing over of fugitives in the interest of law and order.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The next step is then to examine each other's legal systems and procedures to determine compatibility.

sections.label: ASEAN model extradition treaty
sections.summary: ASEAN has been discussing a model ASEAN Extradition Treaty to serve as a template for member states' bilateral negotiations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Compatibility of legal systems is one of them, obviously.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: But in the context of our neighbours, I am able to say that Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) has been discussing a model ASEAN Extradition Treaty as a sort of template, and this model will, when finalised, provide a useful basis for ASEAN member states in their own bilateral negotiations for extradition treaties with one another.
